title: scutellaria ovalifolia var. hirsuta
intro: Scutellaria ovalifolia var. hirsuta, commonly known as a variety of Chinese skullcap, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The health benefits of Scutellaria ovalifolia var. hirsuta include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Scutellaria ovalifolia var. hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
